name: Coming home: when to fire the deorbit burn
description: A two-stage rocket reaches orbit, waits, then fires its engine backwards until the low point of its orbit is 30 km up, inside the atmosphere, and falls back. The sweep changes how long it waits (step 4 of the flight program): every minute of waiting moves the landing point about 450 km further round the Earth. Watch the dynamic pressure graph: coming back in, the air pushes over three times as hard as on the way up.
